# UNGASIS OS v4.0

> Unified Generative AI System for Independent Solopreneurs. A Markdown-first knowledge repo providing token efficiency, multi-agent orchestration, and production readiness frameworks.

## Key Files
- [LLM_CONTEXT.md](LLM_CONTEXT.md): Project passport — read this first
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Cross-tool agent configuration
- [GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md): Antigravity IDE project rules
- [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md): Current session state
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview

## Modules
- [Token Policy](modules/ungasis-token-policy.md): Complete token budget guide
- [Failure Taxonomy](modules/ungasis-failure-taxonomy.md): Agent failure categories
- [Antigravity Guide](modules/ungasis-antigravity.md): Antigravity ecosystem
- [Cross-Device](modules/ungasis-cross-device.md): 4-device workflow
- [Device Sync](modules/ungasis-device-sync.md): Context sync protocol
- [Extended Memory](modules/ungasis-extended-memory.md): Memory patterns

## Configuration
- [config/](config/): 9 orchestration YAML configs
- [.agents/](agents/): Antigravity rules, skills, workflows
- [.clinerules/](.clinerules/): Cline agent rules
